input.message:
The dark/light switch in the customer portal now has the circular reveal and the animated icon. It's committed on its own branch; nothing is merged or deployed.

**Branch / commit:** `feature/theme-transition` @ `32669aa736`, worktree `/tank/nxeon-wt-theme`. It touches 5 files, all added by explicit path: `app/globals.css` (one new block at the end), `components/nx/ThemeToggle.tsx`, the new `components/nx/themeTransition.ts`, the new `test/theme-transition.test.ts` and `docs/DOCUMENTATION.md`. Nothing else is touched, so it should stay clear of the chat, offers, directory and CPU work.

**What I found first:** the theme is a custom one, not next-themes. `data-theme="light"` goes on `<html>`, the choice is kept in localStorage as `nx-theme`, and the inline script in `app/layout.tsx` that prevents a flash of the wrong theme still works and is unchanged. The light colours live in `:root.nx-portal[data-theme="light"]` in `globals.css`. The toggle only appears in the `/dashboard` top bar. Admin uses its own `data-adm-*` theming with no toggle, and the marketing site has no toggle, so neither is affected.

**How it works:**
- **Choosing a mode:** each click picks one of three:
  - **Reveal:** `document.startViewTransition` captures the old theme, flips `data-theme`, then a `clip-path` circle on `::view-transition-new(root)` grows from the centre of the button to the farthest corner. It runs 520 ms with `cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)`.
  - **Fade:** where that API is missing, a 240 ms cross-fade of colours only. Nothing changes size or position, so there's no layout shift.
  - **Instant:** with `prefers-reduced-motion`, or when the tab is hidden.
- **Scoping:** the new CSS only applies while a switch is running (a temporary `nx-theme-vt` class), so any other view transition added later keeps the browser default.
- **Fixed elements, canvases, iframes:** the browser animates a flat image of the screen, so fixed elements, canvases and iframes (noVNC console, charts) are not re-mounted or moved. The captures confirm this.
- **Rapid toggling:** a new switch ends the one still running, and the switch reads the most recently requested theme when it applies, so the page can't end up on a stale theme. There is also a 2.5 s watchdog that ends a stuck reveal, but leaves alone one that has been paused in DevTools.
- **Icon:** sun and moon are stacked and rotate and scale past each other. The moon is violet (#a99bff) and the sun cyan (#67e8f9). A one-off ring in the brand gradient (#3b6be8 → #7b3fef → brand-c) pulses on click, and never on first load.
- **Accessibility:** it's now a plain button with `aria-pressed` and a fixed `aria-label="Light theme"`, replacing `role="switch"`/`aria-checked`. I added a brand-coloured focus ring, and focus stays on the button through the switch.
- **Navigating away:** if the customer leaves the portal before the switch applies, it does nothing, so the light theme can't leak onto marketing pages.

**Browser support:**
- Chrome/Edge 111+, Safari 18+ and Firefox 144+ get the circular reveal.
- Older Firefox and Safari get the colour fade.
- With reduced motion on, the switch is instant: the icon swaps with no rotation and the ring is hidden.

**One limit, built into how browsers run these transitions:** during the half-second reveal the page doesn't take mouse clicks, so a second mouse click in that window is lost. Keyboard presses still work, and five rapid presses followed by four more ended in a consistent theme, saved setting and `aria-pressed` state.

**Testing:**
- **Unit tests:** 8 new tests pass (mode choice, circle origin and radius, edge cases, aria and CSS scoping). `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean.
- **Full suite:** 3218 pass, 45 fail. 43 match the 46-name baseline. The other two passed when re-run on their own and look timing-sensitive under the box's load average of about 48:
  - "a missing account costs the same bcrypt work as a wrong password" (`auth-lockouts.test.ts`)
  - "HARD STOP at the window's end…" (`backup-node-runner.test.ts`)
- **Playwright:** run on a throwaway dev server on port 3187 with a fake database address, so it couldn't reach the production database. It used the real portal shell with a test page containing a canvas, an iframe and a fixed element.
  - Both directions work at 1440 and 390 px.
  - Layout was identical after switching.
  - There were no console errors or hydration warnings.
  - Reduced motion was instant, the fallback fade worked, Space and Enter both toggle, and the choice survives a reload.

The dev server is stopped (killed by its port's PID) and the test page is deleted, with a copy kept in the notes. One gap: the last change, the navigate-away guard, came after the final Playwright run. It is covered by tsc and the unit tests only.

The parent restart wiped my scratchpad, but the screenshots and test scripts were saved outside it and survived.

**Screenshots:** in `/root/agent-notes/theme-transition/`:
- `reveal-{1440,390}-{dark-to-light,light-to-dark}-{000..520}ms.png` and `-done.png`
- `fallback-fade-{dir}-{000..240}ms.png`
- `reduced-motion-after-click.png`

The dark/light switch in the customer portal now has the circular reveal and the animated icon. It's committed on its own branch; nothing is merged or deployed.

**Branch / commit:** `feature/theme-transition` @ `32669aa736`, worktree `/tank/nxeon-wt-theme`. It touches 5 files, all added by explicit path: `app/globals.css` (one new block at the end), `components/nx/ThemeToggle.tsx`, the new `components/nx/themeTransition.ts`, the new `test/theme-transition.test.ts` and `docs/DOCUMENTATION.md`. Nothing else is touched, so it should stay clear of the chat, offers, directory and CPU work.

**What I found first:** the theme is a custom one, not next-themes. `data-theme="light"` goes on `<html>`, the choice is kept in localStorage as `nx-theme`, and the inline script in `app/layout.tsx` that prevents a flash of the wrong theme still works and is unchanged. The light colours live in `:root.nx-portal[data-theme="light"]` in `globals.css`. The toggle only appears in the `/dashboard` top bar. Admin uses its own `data-adm-*` theming with no toggle, and the marketing site has no toggle, so neither is affected.

**How it works:**
- **Choosing a mode:** each click picks one of three:
  - **Reveal:** `document.startViewTransition` captures the old theme, flips `data-theme`, then a `clip-path` circle on `::view-transition-new(root)` grows from the centre of the button to the farthest corner. It runs 520 ms with `cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)`.
  - **Fade:** where that API is missing, a 240 ms cross-fade of colours only. Nothing changes size or position, so there's no layout shift.
  - **Instant:** with `prefers-reduced-motion`, or when the tab is hidden.
- **Scoping:** the new CSS only applies while a switch is running (a temporary `nx-theme-vt` class), so any other view transition added later keeps the browser default.
- **Fixed elements, canvases, iframes:** the browser animates a flat image of the screen, so fixed elements, canvases and iframes (noVNC console, charts) are not re-mounted or moved. The captures confirm this.
- **Rapid toggling:** a new switch ends the one still running, and the switch reads the most recently requested theme when it applies, so the page can't end up on a stale theme. There is also a 2.5 s watchdog that ends a stuck reveal, but leaves alone one that has been paused in DevTools.
- **Icon:** sun and moon are stacked and rotate and scale past each other. The moon is violet (#a99bff) and the sun cyan (#67e8f9). A one-off ring in the brand gradient (#3b6be8 → #7b3fef → brand-c) pulses on click, and never on first load.
- **Accessibility:** it's now a plain button with `aria-pressed` and a fixed `aria-label="Light theme"`, replacing `role="switch"`/`aria-checked`. I added a brand-coloured focus ring, and focus stays on the button through the switch.
- **Navigating away:** if the customer leaves the portal before the switch applies, it does nothing, so the light theme can't leak onto marketing pages.

**Browser support:**
- Chrome/Edge 111+, Safari 18+ and Firefox 144+ get the circular reveal.
- Older Firefox and Safari get the colour fade.
- With reduced motion on, the switch is instant: the icon swaps with no rotation and the ring is hidden.

**One limit, built into how browsers run these transitions:** during the half-second reveal the page doesn't take mouse clicks, so a second mouse click in that window is lost. Keyboard presses still work, and five rapid presses followed by four more ended in a consistent theme, saved setting and `aria-pressed` state.

**Testing:**
- **Unit tests:** 8 new tests pass (mode choice, circle origin and radius, edge cases, aria and CSS scoping). `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean.
- **Full suite:** 3218 pass, 45 fail. 43 match the 46-name baseline. The other two passed when re-run on their own and look timing-sensitive under the box's load average of about 48:
  - "a missing account costs the same bcrypt work as a wrong password" (`auth-lockouts.test.ts`)
  - "HARD STOP at the window's end…" (`backup-node-runner.test.ts`)
- **Playwright:** run on a throwaway dev server on port 3187 with a fake database address, so it couldn't reach the production database. It used the real portal shell with a test page containing a canvas, an iframe and a fixed element.
  - Both directions work at 1440 and 390 px.
  - Layout was identical after switching.
  - There were no console errors or hydration warnings.
  - Reduced motion was instant, the fallback fade worked, Space and Enter both toggle, and the choice survives a reload.

The dev server is stopped (killed by its port's PID) and the test page is deleted, with a copy kept in the notes. One gap: the last change, the navigate-away guard, came after the final Playwright run. It is covered by tsc and the unit tests only.
